notes: «حدثنا أبي قال» names the father of Ja'far with no name, so it is a relation link (rule 7). The name is not in the text and is not completed.
Jabir is the last link: «فحدثنا أن رسول الله» is his report. We came to him («أتينا جابر») is the scene.

fixes.reason: K6I names the father of Ja'far as al-Baqir, a name the text does not write; the text has only the relation «أبي».

evidence.quote: محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي الباقر
